<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow figure</title>
<style>
  html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 240px; height: 294px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 294, false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NoToneMapping;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-100, 140, 230, -64, 1, 1500);
ref.name = 'reference-camera';
ref.position.set(0, 0, 540);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const grainGLSL = `
  float grainHash(vec2 p) {
    vec3 q = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
    q += dot(q, q.yzx + 33.33);
    return fract((q.x + q.y) * q.z);
  }
  vec3 frameGrain(vec2 frag, float amount) {
    vec2 p = floor(frag);
    float alternating = mod(p.x + p.y, 2.0) - 0.5;
    float neutral = (grainHash(p) - 0.5) * 0.78 + alternating * 0.22;
    float tint = grainHash(p + vec2(37.0, 19.0)) - 0.5;
    return amount * (vec3(neutral) + tint * vec3(0.44, -0.10, -0.48));
  }
`;

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    depthWrite: false,
    depthTest: false,
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 screenUV;
      void main() {
        screenUV = uv;
        gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.999, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      varying vec2 screenUV;
      ${grainGLSL}
      void main() {
        float row = (1.0 - screenUV.y) * 294.0;
        float top = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - row / 111.0), 1.85);
        float bottom = pow(max(0.0, (row - 194.0) / 100.0), 1.52);
        vec3 color = mix(vec3(0.994, 0.994, 0.985),
                         vec3(0.802, 0.805, 0.778), top);
        color = mix(color, vec3(0.666, 0.678, 0.647), bottom);
        float edge = pow(abs(screenUV.x * 2.0 - 1.0), 1.65);
        color -= edge * (0.005 + 0.026 * top + 0.018 * bottom);
        color += frameGrain(gl_FragCoord.xy, 0.020 + 0.023 * (top + bottom));
        gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(color, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0);
      }
    `
  })
);
backdrop.name = 'seamless-gray-background';
backdrop.frustumCulled = false;
backdrop.renderOrder = -100;
scene.add(backdrop);

scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xfffaf4, 0.86));
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffcf2, 0xbdb7ac, 1.12));

function light(name, color, intensity, x, y, z) {
  const lamp = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  lamp.name = name;
  lamp.position.set(x, y, z);
  scene.add(lamp);
}
light('upper-left-key', 0xfff8e9, 1.62, -180, 238, 350);
light('front-right-fill', 0xf4f6ff, 0.58, 190, 65, 230);
light('upper-back-fill', 0xfff5dc, 0.84, -95, 190, -250);
light('lower-back-fill', 0xeef3ff, 0.57, 150, -35, -230);

const skin = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  vertexColors: true,
  roughness: 0.96,
  metalness: 0
});
skin.onBeforeCompile = shader => {
  shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
    .replace('void main() {', `${grainGLSL}\nvoid main() {`)
    .replace('#include <colorspace_fragment>', `
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
      gl_FragColor.rgb = clamp(
        gl_FragColor.rgb + frameGrain(gl_FragCoord.xy, 0.044), 0.0, 1.0
      );
    `);
};

const point = (x, row, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x - 100, 230 - row, z);
const origin = new THREE.Vector3();
const axisX = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0);
const axisZ = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
const down = new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0);
const smooth = (lo, hi, x) => THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(x, lo, hi);
const lerp = THREE.MathUtils.lerp;
const clamp = THREE.MathUtils.clamp;
const square = x => x * x;

function part(parent, name, x, row, z) {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = name;
  group.userData.anchor = point(x, row, z);
  group.position.copy(group.userData.anchor).sub(parent.userData.anchor || origin);
  parent.add(group);
  return group;
}

function palette(stops) {
  const colors = stops.map(([row, hex]) => [row, new THREE.Color(hex)]);
  return row => {
    if (row <= colors[0][0]) return colors[0][1].clone();
    for (let i = 1; i < colors.length; i++) {
      const [hi, end] = colors[i];
      if (row <= hi) {
        const [lo, start] = colors[i - 1];
        return start.clone().lerp(end, (row - lo) / (hi - lo));
      }
    }
    return colors[colors.length - 1][1].clone();
  };
}

// Monotone cubic interpolation for both the cross sections and the pose tracks.
function profile(keys, value) {
  const last = keys.length - 1;
  if (value <= keys[0][0]) return keys[0].slice(1);
  if (value >= keys[last][0]) return keys[last].slice(1);
  let i = 0;
  while (value > keys[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = keys[i];
  const b = keys[i + 1];
  const length = b[0] - a[0];
  const t = (value - a[0]) / length;
  const t2 = t * t;
  const t3 = t2 * t;
  const slope = (j, k) => (keys[j + 1][k] - keys[j][k]) /
    (keys[j + 1][0] - keys[j][0]);
  const tangent = (j, k) => {
    if (j === 0) return slope(0, k);
    if (j === last) return slope(last - 1, k);
    const before = slope(j - 1, k);
    const after = slope(j, k);
    return before * after <= 0 ? 0 : 2 * before * after / (before + after);
  };
  return a.slice(1).map((v, index) => {
    const k = index + 1;
    return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * v
      + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * length * tangent(i, k)
      + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * b[k]
      + (t3 - t2) * length * tangent(i + 1, k);
  });
}

function loft(parent, name, first, last, rows, sides, surface, pigment, weights) {
  const positions = [], normals = [], colors = [], indices = [];
  const skinIndices = [], skinWeights = [];
  const stride = sides + 1;
  const anchor = parent.userData.anchor;
  for (let j = 0; j <= rows; j++) {
    const row = lerp(first, last, j / rows);
    for (let i = 0; i <= sides; i++) {
      const angle = -Math.PI + 2 * Math.PI * i / sides;
      const vertex = surface(row, angle);
      const along = surface(Math.min(last, row + 0.045), angle)
        .sub(surface(Math.max(first, row - 0.045), angle));
      const around = surface(row, angle + 0.003).sub(surface(row, angle - 0.003));
      const normal = along.cross(around);
      if (normal.lengthSq() < 1e-13) normal.set(0, j === 0 ? 1 : -1, 0);
      normal.normalize();
      const color = pigment(row, angle, vertex);
      colors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
      positions.push(vertex.x - anchor.x, vertex.y - anchor.y, vertex.z - anchor.z);
      normals.push(normal.x, normal.y, normal.z);

      if (weights) {
        const headWeight = weights(row);
        skinIndices.push(0, 1, 0, 0);
        skinWeights.push(1 - headWeight, headWeight, 0, 0);
      }
      if (j < rows && i < sides) {
        const a = j * stride + i;
        const b = a + stride;
        indices.push(a, b, a + 1, a + 1, b, b + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  let mesh;
  if (weights) {
    geo.setAttribute('skinIndex', new THREE.Uint16BufferAttribute(skinIndices, 4));
    geo.setAttribute('skinWeight', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(skinWeights, 4));
    mesh = new THREE.SkinnedMesh(geo, skin);
    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  } else {
    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, skin);
  }
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const figure = part(scene, 'character-yellow-pear', 100, 230, 0);
const torso = part(figure, 'torso', 99, 123, 0);
const head = part(torso, 'head', 100, 63, 5);
const trunkBone = new THREE.Bone();
trunkBone.name = 'torso-skin-bone';
torso.add(trunkBone);
const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
headBone.name = 'head-skin-bone';
head.add(headBone);
const headRest = head.position.clone();

// Section rows give the center, width, and front and back depths.
const bodyKeys = [
  [16.8, 101.6, 0,    1.7, 0,    0],
  [17.7, 101.4, 8.2,  1.9, 6.8,  6.0],
  [20.0, 101.3, 13.5, 2.4, 11.1, 10.8],
  [24.3, 101.0, 17.3, 2.8, 15.4, 14.0],
  [30.0, 100.6, 20.3, 3.2, 18.7, 16.0],
  [37.0, 100.4, 22.3, 3.6, 20.6, 17.2],
  [45.0, 100.5, 24.4, 4.0, 21.8, 17.8],
  [53.0, 100.0, 27.7, 3.8, 22.8, 19.2],
  [63.0, 98.6, 32.4, 2.0, 24.9, 22.5],
  [75.0, 97.6, 39.7, 0.2, 29.4, 27.7],
  [87.0, 97.5, 44.1, -0.5, 35.8, 31.0],
  [100.0, 97.6, 47.1, -0.7, 41.5, 32.5],
  [114.0, 98.3, 49.9, -0.4, 46.2, 34.8],
  [129.0, 99.1, 53.9, 0.4, 49.0, 36.5],
  [144.0, 99.7, 57.0, 1.0, 50.2, 37.0],
  [157.0, 100.0, 57.5, 1.7, 49.2, 35.9],
  [171.0, 100.1, 55.9, 1.9, 45.2, 34.3],
  [183.0, 99.8, 53.1, 1.8, 41.0, 32.5],
  [195.0, 99.4, 49.0, 1.5, 35.9, 29.7],
  [206.0, 98.7, 44.3, 0.8, 29.8, 27.4],
  [216.0, 98.3, 39.1, 0.3, 23.3, 24.0],
  [224.0, 98.1, 32.4, -0.1, 17.6, 20.3],
  [232.0, 98.0, 23.5, 0.1, 11.3, 14.9],
  [238.0, 97.9, 12.2, 1.2, 5.9, 8.7],
  [241.0, 97.9, 0,    1.8, 0,    0]
];

function ovalFalloff(x, row, cx, cy, rx, ry) {
  return Math.exp(-square((x - cx) / rx) - square((row - cy) / ry));
}

function bodyDepth(row, x, c, mid, front, back) {
  const convex = c * (front + back) * 0.5 + c * c * (front - back) * 0.5;
  const rearRoundness = 4.0 * square(Math.min(0, c))
    * ovalFalloff(0, row, 0, 151, 1, 49);
  let face = 0;
  if (row < 65 && c > 0.3) {
    face = smooth(0.3, 0.86, c) * (
      2.25 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 101.3, 43.9, 5.8, 4.7)
      + 0.77 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 90.7, 45.8, 6.8, 4.6)
      + 0.62 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 111.8, 45.6, 6.5, 4.8)
    );
  }
  return mid + convex + face - rearRoundness;
}

const sections = new Map();
function bodySection(row) {
  if (!sections.has(row)) sections.set(row, profile(bodyKeys, row));
  return sections.get(row);
}

function bodySurface(row, angle) {
  const [center, radius, mid, front, back] = bodySection(row);
  const x = center + radius * Math.sin(angle);
  return point(x, row, bodyDepth(row, x, Math.cos(angle), mid, front, back));
}

function faceDepth(x, row) {
  const [center, radius, mid, front, back] = profile(bodyKeys, row);
  const sine = clamp((x - center) / radius, -1, 1);
  return bodyDepth(row, x, Math.sqrt(1 - sine * sine), mid, front, back);
}

const peel = palette([
  [17, 0xe1c96d], [30, 0xdec16a], [43, 0xd6b55c], [53, 0xdab254],
  [70, 0xe6be50], [92, 0xecc95b], [113, 0xe7be52], [140, 0xeac050],
  [161, 0xdfb251], [181, 0xd8a64b], [199, 0xd9a347],
  [216, 0xcf963f], [232, 0xc18a3d], [241, 0xae7535]
]);
const belly = palette([
  [91, 0xf3dfa1], [105, 0xf5e3ac], [126, 0xf3e1b6], [145, 0xe9d6b0],
  [158, 0xe3cba5], [172, 0xdcb990], [187, 0xd9ad6d], [206, 0xd3a04c]
]);
const oliveShade = new THREE.Color(0xa18741);
const cheekGold = new THREE.Color(0xe6c474);
const warmShade = new THREE.Color(0x91612c);

function bodyPigment(row, angle, vertex) {
  const x = vertex.x + 100;
  const front = Math.cos(angle);
  const color = peel(row);
  const u = (x - 104 + (row - 132) * 0.045) / 53.0;
  const top = 92 + 32 * u * u + 5 * u;
  const patch = smooth(-4, 16, row - top)
    * (1 - smooth(170, 204, row + 4 * u * u))
    * smooth(0.05, 0.70, front);
  color.lerp(belly(row), patch * 0.99);
  if (row < 66 && front > 0) {
    const shadows =
      0.30 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 86.8, 39.3, 6.3, 4.8)
      + 0.25 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 115.6, 39.4, 5.8, 4.5)
      + 0.16 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 101.2, 50, 11.9, 3.0);
    color.lerp(oliveShade, shadows * smooth(0.25, 0.72, front));
    color.lerp(cheekGold, 0.17 * ovalFalloff(x, row, 102, 43, 8.5, 3.5));
  }
  color.lerp(warmShade, 0.22 * smooth(214, 240, row)
    * ovalFalloff(x, row, 98, 234, 12, 13));
  return color;
}

const body = loft(torso, 'continuous-head-and-torso-skin', 16.8, 241, 189, 112,
  bodySurface, bodyPigment, row => 1 - smooth(56, 94, row));
sections.clear();

function meshFromFace(group, name, positions, colors, indices) {
  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, skin);
  mesh.name = name;
  group.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function faceVertex(group, positions, x, row, offset) {
  const local = point(x, row, faceDepth(x, row) + offset).sub(group.userData.anchor);
  positions.push(local.x, local.y, local.z);
}

function ovalSurface(group, name, cx, cy, rx, ry, slant, height, cutIn, pigment) {
  const positions = [], colors = [], indices = [];
  const loops = 18, sides = 48;
  for (let i = 0; i <= loops; i++) {
    const r = i / loops;
    for (let j = 0; j <= sides; j++) {
      const a = j / sides * Math.PI * 2;
      const u = r * Math.cos(a);
      const v = r * Math.sin(a);
      const bump = height * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - r * r), 1.24) - cutIn;
      faceVertex(group, positions, cx + rx * u, cy + ry * v + slant * u, bump);
      const c = pigment(r, u, v);
      colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
      if (i < loops && j < sides) {
        const k = i * (sides + 1) + j;
        const n = k + sides + 1;
        indices.push(k, k + 1, n, k + 1, n + 1, n);
      }
    }
  }
  return meshFromFace(group, name, positions, colors, indices);
}

function raisedOval(group, name, cx, cy, rx, ry, slant, height, rim, crown) {
  const edge = new THREE.Color(rim), center = new THREE.Color(crown);
  return ovalSurface(group, name, cx, cy, rx, ry, slant, height, 0.13,
    (r, u, v) => edge.clone().lerp(center, (1 - r * r) * (0.86 - v * 0.12)));
}

const strokeSteps = 28;

function strokePoints(group, begin, end, centerRow, thickness, offset) {
  const positions = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= strokeSteps; i++) {
    const u = 2 * i / strokeSteps - 1;
    const x = lerp(begin, end, i / strokeSteps);
    for (let side = -1; side <= 1; side++) {
      const row = centerRow(u) + thickness(u) * side;
      faceVertex(group, positions, x, row, offset(x, row));
    }
  }
  return positions;
}

function faceStroke(group, name, begin, end, centerRow, thickness, offset, hex) {
  const colors = [], indices = [];
  const mid = new THREE.Color(hex);
  const edge = mid.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color(0xbe9e56), 0.39);
  for (let i = 0; i <= strokeSteps; i++) {
    for (const c of [edge, mid, edge]) colors.push(c.r, c.g, c.b);
    if (i < strokeSteps) {
      const a = i * 3;
      indices.push(a, a + 1, a + 3, a + 1, a + 4, a + 3);
      indices.push(a + 1, a + 2, a + 4, a + 2, a + 5, a + 4);
    }
  }
  return meshFromFace(group, name,
    strokePoints(group, begin, end, centerRow, thickness, offset), colors, indices);
}

const iris = palette([
  [0, 0x111910], [0.45, 0x101b13], [0.51, 0x16251c],
  [0.61, 0x244638], [0.73, 0x538064], [0.84, 0x7c9560],
  [0.92, 0xb0ac65], [1, 0xd5b761]
]);
const glint = new THREE.Color(0xafc1a2);

function makeEye(side, x, row, width, slant) {
  const eye = part(head, `eye-${side}`, x, row, faceDepth(x, row));
  const lid = part(eye, 'closed-eyelid', x, row, faceDepth(x, row));
  const open = part(eye, 'open-eye', x, row, faceDepth(x, row));
  raisedOval(lid, 'soft-upper-lid', x, row, width, 3.25, slant, 1.35,
    0xc5a556, 0xddbe69);
  faceStroke(lid, 'closed-lid-crease', x - width * 0.92, x + width * 0.92,
    u => row + 0.39 + 1.94 * (1 - u * u) + slant * u * 0.92,
    u => 0.38 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u), 0.51),
    (px, py) => {
      const u = (px - x) / width;
      const v = (py - row - slant * u) / 3.25;
      return Math.max(0.08,
        1.35 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u - v * v), 1.24) - 0.07);
    }, 0x9e874c);
  ovalSurface(open, 'green-iris-and-pupil', x, row - 0.7, width + 1.55,
    7.0, slant, 3.05, 0.08, (r, u, v) =>
      iris(r).lerp(glint, 0.25 * ovalFalloff(u, v, -0.26, -0.35, 0.16, 0.13)));
  return { lid, open };
}
const eyes = [
  makeEye('left', 86.8, 37.8, 5.25, 0.26),
  makeEye('right', 115.4, 37.9, 4.95, -0.30)
];

const mouth = part(head, 'mouth', 101, 49.6, faceDepth(101, 49.6));
raisedOval(mouth, 'lower-lip', 101.1, 50.3, 12.4, 1.65, -0.15, 0.70,
  0xcbab60, 0xd9b468);
function mouthCurve(u, expression) {
  const arc = 1 - u * u;
  return 48.35 + 1.54 * arc - 0.09 * u
    + Math.max(expression, 0) * (0.32 + 1.8 * arc)
    + Math.max(-expression, 0) * (2.04 - 3.02 * arc);
}
const mouthThickness = u => 0.66 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u), 0.46);
function mouthDepth(x, row) {
  const u = (x - 101.1) / 12.4;
  const v = (row - 50.3 + 0.15 * u) / 1.65;
  return 0.11 + 0.70 * Math.pow(Math.max(0, 1 - u * u - v * v), 1.24);
}
const mouthLine = faceStroke(mouth, 'lip-crease', 90.4, 111.9,
  u => mouthCurve(u, 0), mouthThickness, mouthDepth, 0x756d42);
mouthLine.frustumCulled = false;

function limb(group, name, keys, pigment, sides = 36, tilt = 0) {
  const first = keys[0][0], last = keys[keys.length - 1][0];
  const sections = new Map();
  const surface = (row, angle) => {
    if (!sections.has(row)) {
      const [x, z, rx, rz] = profile(keys, row);
      let direction = 0;
      if (tilt) {
        const lo = Math.max(first, row - 0.18);
        const hi = Math.min(last, row + 0.18);
        direction = tilt * (profile(keys, hi)[0] - profile(keys, lo)[0]) / (hi - lo);
      }
      sections.set(row, [x, z, rx, rz, direction]);
    }
    const [x, z, rx, rz, direction] = sections.get(row);
    const across = rx * Math.sin(angle) / Math.hypot(1, direction);
    return point(x + across, row - across * direction, z + rz * Math.cos(angle));
  };
  return loft(group, name, first, last, Math.max(16, Math.ceil(last - first)),
    sides, surface, pigment);
}

const leftArmColor = palette([
  [78, 0xe8bf54], [107, 0xe2b950], [135, 0xd6ad4b], [153, 0xc29b44],
  [167, 0xa6843e], [177, 0x7e6a43], [186, 0x62563e], [193, 0x594f3a]
]);
const rightArmColor = palette([
  [80, 0xdfb44e], [111, 0xdbb04a], [140, 0xcba046], [164, 0xbc9040],
  [177, 0x9c7838], [188, 0x756143], [196, 0x60543d]
]);
const raisedArmColor = palette([
  [0, 0xe6bd51], [0.35, 0xe7bd52], [0.60, 0xe4b74a],
  [0.78, 0xd5a642], [0.87, 0xbb9142], [0.94, 0x806945], [1, 0x66563f]
]);
const handColor = palette([
  [183, 0x756345], [190, 0x615640], [198, 0x584e3b],
  [210, 0x51493a], [222, 0x524b3f]
]);
const knuckleColor = new THREE.Color(0x77705b);
function handPigment(row, angle) {
  return handColor(row).lerp(knuckleColor,
    0.19 * smooth(0.12, 0.99, Math.cos(angle - 0.45)));
}

function handBasis(fingers, forward) {
  const y = fingers.clone().negate();
  const x = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(y, forward).normalize();
  const z = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(x, y);
  return new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(x, y, z));
}

function buildArm(side, keys, shoulderRow, elbowRow, wrist, color, tilt) {
  const left = side === 'left';
  const [sx, sz] = profile(keys, shoulderRow);
  const [ex, ez] = profile(keys, elbowRow);
  const arm = part(figure, `arm-${side}`, sx, shoulderRow, sz);
  const forearm = part(arm, `forearm-${side}`, ex, elbowRow, ez);
  const hand = part(forearm, `hand-${side}`, ...wrist);
  const sides = 36;
  const mesh = limb(arm, `${side}-continuous-arm-skin`, keys, color, sides, tilt);
  mesh.frustumCulled = false;
  const geo = mesh.geometry;
  for (const name of ['position', 'normal', 'color']) {
    geo.attributes[name].setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  }

  const first = keys[0][0], last = keys[keys.length - 1][0];
  const rows = Math.ceil(last - first);
  const sections = [];
  const gestureColors = new Float32Array(geo.attributes.color.array.length);
  for (let j = 0; j <= rows; j++) {
    const row = lerp(first, last, j / rows);
    sections.push([row, ...profile(keys, row).slice(2)]);
    const c = raisedArmColor(j / rows);
    for (let i = 0; i <= sides; i++) c.toArray(gestureColors, (j * (sides + 1) + i) * 3);
  }
  const ring = Array.from({ length: sides + 1 }, (_, i) => {
    const a = -Math.PI + 2 * Math.PI * i / sides;
    return [Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a)];
  });
  const restFingers = new THREE.Vector3(left ? -4 : 5.4, -30, 4.5).normalize();

  const rig = {
    arm, forearm, hand, mesh, geo, sides, sections, ring, shoulderRow, elbowRow,
    wristRow: wrist[1], shoulder: arm.userData.anchor,
    elbow: forearm.userData.anchor, wrist: hand.userData.anchor, digits: [],
    handBasisInverse: handBasis(restFingers, axisZ).invert(),
    restPositions: geo.attributes.position.array.slice(),
    restNormals: geo.attributes.normal.array.slice(),
    restColors: geo.attributes.color.array.slice(),
    gestureColors
  };
  rig.neutralFit = new Float32Array(rig.restPositions.length);
  sweepArm(rig, rig.shoulder, rig.elbow, rig.wrist, 0, rig.neutralFit);
  return rig;
}

function hermite(out, tangent, a, b, da, db, t) {
  const t2 = t * t, t3 = t2 * t;
  out.copy(a).multiplyScalar(2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1)
    .addScaledVector(da, t3 - 2 * t2 + t)
    .addScaledVector(b, -2 * t3 + 3 * t2)
    .addScaledVector(db, t3 - t2);
  tangent.copy(a).multiplyScalar(6 * t2 - 6 * t)
    .addScaledVector(da, 3 * t2 - 4 * t + 1)
    .addScaledVector(b, -6 * t2 + 6 * t)
    .addScaledVector(db, 3 * t2 - 2 * t).normalize();
}

function sweepArm(rig, shoulder, elbow, wrist, gesture, output) {
  const elbowLocal = elbow.clone().sub(shoulder);
  const wristLocal = wrist.clone().sub(shoulder);
  const upper = elbowLocal.clone().normalize();
  const lower = wristLocal.clone().sub(elbowLocal).normalize();
  const bend = upper.clone().add(lower).normalize();
  const upperLength = elbowLocal.length();
  const lowerLength = wristLocal.distanceTo(elbowLocal);
  const shoulderTangent = upper.clone().multiplyScalar(upperLength * 0.91);
  const elbowIn = bend.clone().multiplyScalar(upperLength * 0.76);
  const elbowOut = bend.clone().multiplyScalar(lowerLength * 0.76);
  const wristTangent = lower.clone().multiplyScalar(lowerLength * 0.94);
  const center = new THREE.Vector3(), tangent = new THREE.Vector3();
  const side = new THREE.Vector3(), front = new THREE.Vector3();
  const previous = upper.clone();
  const turn = new THREE.Quaternion();
  const frame = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(down, previous);
  const { shoulderRow, elbowRow, wristRow } = rig;
  let k = 0;
  for (const [row, rx, rz] of rig.sections) {
    if (row < shoulderRow) {
      tangent.copy(upper);
      center.copy(upper).multiplyScalar(row - shoulderRow);
    } else if (row < elbowRow) {
      hermite(center, tangent, origin, elbowLocal, shoulderTangent, elbowIn,
        (row - shoulderRow) / (elbowRow - shoulderRow));
    } else if (row <= wristRow) {
      hermite(center, tangent, elbowLocal, wristLocal, elbowOut, wristTangent,
        (row - elbowRow) / (wristRow - elbowRow));
    } else {
      tangent.copy(lower);
      center.copy(wristLocal).addScaledVector(lower, row - wristRow);
    }
    turn.setFromUnitVectors(previous, tangent);
    frame.premultiply(turn).normalize();
    previous.copy(tangent);
    const fullness = 1 + 0.30 * gesture * (1 - smooth(elbowRow - 4, wristRow, row));
    side.copy(axisX).applyQuaternion(frame).multiplyScalar(rx * fullness);
    front.copy(axisZ).applyQuaternion(frame).multiplyScalar(rz * fullness);
    for (const [sine, cosine] of rig.ring) {
      output[k++] = center.x + side.x * sine + front.x * cosine;
      output[k++] = center.y + side.y * sine + front.y * cosine;
      output[k++] = center.z + side.z * sine + front.z * cosine;
    }
  }
}

function rootMatrix(values) {
  const [x, row, sx, sy, sz, yaw, pitch, roll] = values;
  const rotation = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(pitch, yaw, roll, 'YXZ'));
  return new THREE.Matrix4().compose(point(x, row, 0), rotation, new THREE.Vector3(sx, sy, sz));
}

function compileArm(rig, poses) {
  const rotations = [];
  const values = poses.map((pose, i) => {
    if (pose === null) {
      rotations.push(new THREE.Quaternion());
      return [poseTimes[i], ...rig.elbow.toArray(), ...rig.wrist.toArray(), 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0];
    }
    const [e, w, aim, twist, curl, spread, emphasis, size, reach, lift] = pose;
    const inverse = rootMatrix(placement[i].slice(1)).invert();
    const eLocal = point(...e).applyMatrix4(inverse);
    const wLocal = point(...w).applyMatrix4(inverse);
    const direction = new THREE.Vector3(aim[0], -aim[1], aim[2]).transformDirection(inverse);
    const forward = axisZ.clone().transformDirection(inverse);
    const rotation = handBasis(direction, forward);
    rotation.premultiply(new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(direction, twist));
    rotation.multiply(rig.handBasisInverse);
    rotations.push(rotation);
    return [poseTimes[i], ...eLocal.toArray(), ...wLocal.toArray(),
      curl, spread, emphasis, size, reach, lift];
  });
  rotations.push(rotations[rotations.length - 1].clone());
  rig.motion = closeTrack(values);
  rig.handRotations = rotations;
}

function smoothArmNormals(rig) {
  rig.geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const normal = rig.geo.attributes.normal;
  const seam = new THREE.Vector3();
  const stride = rig.sides + 1;
  for (let j = 0; j < rig.sections.length; j++) {
    const a = j * stride, b = a + rig.sides;
    seam.set(normal.getX(a) + normal.getX(b),
             normal.getY(a) + normal.getY(b),
             normal.getZ(a) + normal.getZ(b)).normalize();
    normal.setXYZ(a, seam.x, seam.y, seam.z);
    normal.setXYZ(b, seam.x, seam.y, seam.z);
  }
}

const splay = [0.54, 0.20, 0, -0.20, -0.40];

function poseArm(rig, time, segment, handMix) {
  const [ex, ey, ez, wx, wy, wz, curl, spread, emphasis, size, reach, lift] =
    profile(rig.motion, time);
  const elbow = new THREE.Vector3(ex, ey, ez);
  const wrist = new THREE.Vector3(wx, wy, wz);
  const shoulder = rig.shoulder.clone();
  shoulder.y += lift;
  shoulder.z += reach;
  rig.arm.position.copy(shoulder);
  rig.forearm.position.copy(elbow).sub(shoulder);
  rig.hand.position.copy(wrist).sub(elbow);
  rig.hand.quaternion.slerpQuaternions(rig.handRotations[segment],
    rig.handRotations[segment + 1], handMix);
  rig.hand.scale.setScalar(size);

  const side = rig === left ? 1 : -1;
  rig.digits.forEach((joint, i) => {
    const fingerCurl = i === 0 ? 0.33 : 0.48 + i * 0.095;
    joint.rotation.set(-curl * fingerCurl, 0, side * spread * splay[i], 'ZXY');
  });

  const { position, normal, color } = rig.geo.attributes;
  if (emphasis <= 0) {
    position.array.set(rig.restPositions);
    normal.array.set(rig.restNormals);
    color.array.set(rig.restColors);
  } else {
    sweepArm(rig, shoulder, elbow, wrist, emphasis, position.array);
    for (let i = 0; i < position.array.length; i++) {
      position.array[i] += (rig.restPositions[i] - rig.neutralFit[i]) * (1 - emphasis);
      color.array[i] = lerp(rig.restColors[i], rig.gestureColors[i], emphasis * 0.91);
    }
    smoothArmNormals(rig);
  }
  position.needsUpdate = true;
  normal.needsUpdate = true;
  color.needsUpdate = true;
  rig.geo.computeBoundingBox();
}

function poseFace(time, expression) {
  const [openness] = profile(blink, time);
  for (const eye of eyes) {
    eye.open.visible = openness > 0.045;
    eye.open.scale.y = Math.max(0.04, openness);
    eye.lid.visible = openness < 0.43;
    eye.lid.scale.y = 1 - 0.60 * openness;
  }
  const geo = mouthLine.geometry;
  geo.attributes.position.array.set(strokePoints(mouth, 90.4, 111.9,
    u => mouthCurve(u, expression), mouthThickness, mouthDepth));
  geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  geo.computeBoundingBox();
}

function render(t = 0) {
  const time = ((t % period) + period) % period;
  const [x, row, sx, sy, sz, yaw, pitch, roll] = profile(placement, time);
  figure.position.copy(point(x, row, 0));
  figure.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  figure.rotation.set(pitch, yaw, roll, 'YXZ');

  const [hx, hy, hz, headYaw, headPitch, headRoll, expression] = profile(headMotion, time);
  head.position.set(headRest.x + hx, headRest.y + hy, headRest.z + hz);
  head.rotation.set(headPitch, headYaw, headRoll, 'YXZ');
  poseFace(time, expression);

  const [leftPitch, leftRoll, rightPitch, rightRoll] = profile(legMotion, time);
  leftLeg.rotation.set(leftPitch, 0, leftRoll);
  rightLeg.rotation.set(rightPitch, 0, rightRoll);
  leftFoot.rotation.x = -leftPitch * 0.68;
  rightFoot.rotation.x = -rightPitch * 0.68;

  let segment = 0;
  while (time > placement[segment + 1][0]) segment++;
  const handMix = smooth(placement[segment][0], placement[segment + 1][0], time);
  poseArm(left, time, segment, handMix);
  poseArm(right, time, segment, handMix);

  body.boundingBox = null;
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.setViewport(0, 0, 240, 294);
  renderer.setScissorTest(false);
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters: [figure], render, ready: true };
</script>
</body>
